description:
KitchDo is a checklist app for home kitchens and small teams. Build lists once, run them on a schedule, and see what actually got done.

Use it for opening and closing, cleaning, prep, and the jobs that slip when the room is busy.

Complete lists offline; they sync when you are back online. Invite with a short code or a QR code. Choose who can edit templates and who can only run them.
promotionalText: Kitchen checklists for home and small teams. Owner pays; joiners stay free.
whatsNew:
After you confirm your email, you go straight into KitchDo — no more blank screen.

Start a household or a business in two steps, or join with a code. Creating a list is clearer, and you can swipe to delete one.

Assigned tasks still ping a closed phone. Privacy Policy and Terms of Use are in Settings.
